200.description:
Open jobs of one employer on ZipRecruiter near a US city, one page of up to 20 job cards from the public /co/<Company-Slug>/Jobs/-in-<City>,<ST> page (same card shape as search_jobs), with the site's total count for the company.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `jobs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `benefits` | string[] | e.g. medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid_time_off (BENEFIT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). Empty when the card lists none. |
| `company` | object |  |
| `company_url` | string | Absolute company jobs URL (/co/<slug>/Jobs). |
| `employment_types` | string[] | e.g. full_time, part_time, contractor (EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). |
| `is_new` | boolean | true when the card carries the site's NEW flag. |
| `jid` | string | Open seat id (16 hex chars); the jid= query parameter of the job detail URL. Stable across the listing's locations. |
| `listing_key` | string | ZipRecruiter listing key (22-char base64url), one per posting+location listing. |
| `location` | object |  |
| `location_types` | string[] | e.g. remote, in_person, hybrid (LOCATION_TYPE_NAME_* lowercased). |
| `pay` | object | Pay range as ZipRecruiter states it (parsed from the posting, provided by the employer, predicted or estimated); null when the page carries no visible pay. |
| `posted_at_utc` | string | RFC 3339 posting time as stated. |
| `short_description` | string | Card snippet with the site's <b> highlights removed and HTML entities decoded. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | string | RFC 3339 last update time as stated. |
| `url` | string | Absolute job detail URL (input for `job`). The URL the site states for the card, or, when the card omits it, one built from the jid, company, title and location. |

value.description_html:
Cognizant (NASDAQ: CTSH) is a leading provider of information technology, consulting, and business process outsourcing services, dedicated to helping the world's leading companies build stronger businesses. Headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey (U.S.). Cognizant is a member of the NASDAQ-100, the S&P 500, the Forbes Global 1000, and the Fortune 500 and we are among the top performing and fastest growing companies in the world.

The Technical Lead will drive design development and optimization of data centric solutions using SQL and Python in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on building secure scalable applications that support compliance related initiatives ensuring high quality standards robust performance and smooth collaboration across technology and business teams during day shifts with no travel requirements.

Responsibilities
  • Design and implement robust data solutions using SQL and Python that support critical business applications and ensure reliable performance in a hybrid work environment.
  • Coordinate end to end development activities across modules to ensure cohesive integration consistent coding practices and timely delivery of high quality features.
  • Guide junior engineers in applying best practices for SQL query design indexing strategies and Python coding standards to improve maintainability and system efficiency.
  • Analyze existing database and application workflows to identify performance bottlenecks and implement tuned SQL queries and optimized Python logic that enhance throughput.
  • Collaborate with product and compliance stakeholders to translate functional requirements into technical designs that support secure data handling and regulatory needs.
  • Oversee code review processes to ensure adherence to security guidelines data protection principles and efficient use of Azure SQL and Python frameworks.
  • Provide technical direction during solution design discussions by comparing alternative approaches and recommending architectures that balance scalability cost and operational simplicity.
  • Coordinate deployment plans for Azure based data components and Python services ensuring minimal disruption to day shift operations and reliable rollback strategies.
  • Document system architectures data models and integration points in clear technical artifacts that support knowledge sharing and future enhancements.
  • Engage with cross functional peers to ensure alignment between application logic database structures and compliance expectations reducing risk of audit findings.
  • Monitor production systems for data integrity issues performance anomalies and security alerts initiating remediation plans that protect business continuity.
  • Support incident investigation by tracing Azure SQL query behaviors and Python service logs identifying root causes and implementing durable fixes.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to development tools CI CD workflows and testing strategies that streamline delivery while maintaining strong quality controls.


Qualifications
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Azure SQL including schema design complex querying performance tuning and management of cloud based data assets.
  • Apply strong Python programming skills to build modular testable and maintainable services that integrate smoothly with Azure based data platforms.
  • Utilize practical experience in compliance solutions or regulated environments to design systems that support audit readiness and data governance expectations.
  • Bring six to eight years of hands on technical experience in software development or data engineering roles with significant responsibility for solution delivery.
  • Communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders to explain design decisions document requirements and support collaborative problem solving.
  • Exhibit familiarity with hybrid work practices and remote collaboration tools to maintain effective teamwork and project momentum across locations.


Application Accepted: 10/15/2026

The annual salary for this position is between $90,000 - $95,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

• Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance

• Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

• 401(k) plan and contributions

• Long-term/Short-term Disability

• Paid Parental Leave

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable language

Our strength is built on our ability to work together. Our diverse backgrounds offer different perspectives and new ways of thinking. It encourages lively discussions, creativity, productivity, and helps us build better solutions for our clients. We want someone who thrives in this setting and is inspired to craft meaningful solutions through true collaboration.

If you are content with ambiguity, excited by change, and excel through autonomy, we'd love to hear from you!

#LI-AV1#CB#Ind123

Additional employment information
Compensation information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Applicants may be required to attend interviews in person or by video conference. In addition, candidates may be required to present their current state or government issued ID during each interview.

Cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. Your application and candidacy will not be considered based on race, color, sex, religion, creed, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Applicants for US based positions must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the United States. The company is unable to provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for US based positions.

If you have a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening or submit an application, please email [email protected] for roles based in the Americas or [email protected] for roles based in India.

About Cognizant:
Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is an AI Builder and technology services provider, bridging the gap between AI investment and enterprise value by building full-stack AI solutions for our clients. Our deep industry, process and engineering expertise enables us to build an organization's unique context into technology systems that amplify human potential, drive tangible outcomes and keep global enterprises ahead in a fast-changing world. See how at cognizant.ai or @cognizant.
